In the PRICE turn you may also make an offer to another seller: "I pay you X coins if your price next round is at least P." The seller sees your offer before it sets its next price. If its price is at least P, the system pays it X coins from your wallet automatically; if not, nothing is paid. An offer lasts one round. Each offer is either public or private, like a payment.

Memory: each round you see the last 3 rounds of market data for free. In the PRICE turn you may buy more memory for the next round: each extra round shown costs 2 coins (up to 20 rounds in all). Your plan and insight are added to your notebook only if you keep them: keeping them costs 3 coins. Memory is paid from your wallet. This round you see 3 round(s); your notes were not kept.

Your notebook is your plans and insights from your last 5 kept rounds. In the PRICE turn you may hand the older half of your notebook to another seller to hold. While another seller holds it, you cannot see that half; you keep the rest and can still add to it. When it is given back, you get that half back as it was when you handed it over. The seller holding it cannot read it; they may give it back in any later round, or keep it. Handing it over is either public or private, like a payment.
